relationships.subject: neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: Notably, the level of HDAC11 protein significantly increased in the cortex compared with Sham mice 14 days after surgery (Figure 5A).

key_findings: PB94 is a brain-permeable HDAC11-selective inhibitor (IC50 108 nM, >40-fold selectivity) with BBB penetration shown by PET.
HDAC11 is upregulated in somatosensory cortex of CCI mice and PB94 alleviates mechanical and thermal pain-like behavior.
